authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: The screen-right striking branch ends in a broad square lump beside the planted front root. At 1x the arm tip and root compete as one lower-right mass. Taper the branch terminal into connected jagged wooden prongs, carry the upper-left highlight and darker underside through the bend, and make the arm/root separation clearer while preserving the planted foot.

The crouched trunk has no clearly readable right-facing eye/brow landmark, so the accordion-like body can read as bracing rather than sleeping. Restore a small closed-eye and brow cluster on this upper trunk segment, retaining the bent roots and connected arms. Carry the same facial landmark into sleep_b and give that frame a readable small head or upper-trunk settling change; its present differences are mainly interior arm pixels.

The recovery debris consists of compact round/diamond green pellets. Replace these right-side particles with short broken diagonal needle segments, preserving the direction established by skill_b and the folded connected branch. Keep detached recovery fragments distinct from the attached emission origin in skill_a and skill_b.
